summary: AIFU Inc., a Shenzhen-based, Nasdaq-listed insurance services group (successor to Fanhua/AIX), filed a 6-K reporting completion on November 6, 2026, of its acquisition of 100% of Waltz Investment Holding Ltd., which indirectly owns 99% of Shenzhen Waltz New Material Applied Technology and subsidiaries. Total consideration is approximately RMB300 million: 11,203,443 Class A shares at US$3.00 per share plus US$11,000,000 cash payable to Modern within 365 days post-closing. Sellers received shares split across Ballet, Timber, Modern and Sunrise, and now hold ~15.48% of shares outstanding but only ~1.03% of voting power, subject to a 60-month lock-up. Shares were issued privately under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S as restricted securities. Watch post-closing integration, the deferred cash obligation, and any overhang once lock-ups lapse.
